title: Emend document identity map
description: The whole committed `.emend/docs.json` file (TD §3.2b): maps a per-doc UUID (minted at first sidecar write) to the project-relative path that document currently lives at. A rename/move is one map update (FR-ED-8); scratch-doc adoption mints a UUID on save-in. Non-JSONL, single-writer by design (TD-4) — the file always holds the *current* map, not a history. Producer/consumer: `store::docs_map`/`store::service::SidecarStore` (P2a-10, FR-X-8).

documents.description: Keyed by the per-doc UUID; each value is the document's current project-relative path.
